mechanism.claim: A high-variation completed eight-hour BTC block with high lag-one autocorrelation of absolute one-minute returns exhibits endogenous volatility clustering rather than an isolated shock. When the full block and final two hours agree in direction, the active information-arrival episode should continue in that direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVACR measures serial dependence in return magnitudes after removing direction. The prior serial-autocorrelation candidate correlates signed returns; variance-ratio compares aggregated signed-return variance; HAR surprise forecasts total variation; sign entropy and sign runs discard magnitudes. HVACR uses no flow, volume, funding, OI, cross-assets, prior event rows, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal realized-variation rank explicitly restricts activation to elevated volatility, while the clustering tail requires repeated rather than isolated turbulence
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC magnitude-clustering onsets with an eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.returns: 479 close-to-close log returns inside the completed block
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute returns), strict positive
features.absolute_return_autocorrelation: Pearson correlation between abs(return[t]) and abs(return[t-1]) across the 479 completed-block close-to-close returns; both vectors must have finite positive standard deviation
features.clustering_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h) over final two hours
features.direction_confirmation: block and late returns have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
